title: Detailed cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e07b39'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8561f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='potRim' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f09a5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d06a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cactusBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2e9e5b'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#4ecb6f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1f7a44'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cactusArm' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3cb85f'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5cd97d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#25834a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='soil' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6b4a2e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a3220'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M26 62 L74 62 L68 94 Q67 97 64 97 L36 97 Q33 97 32 94 Z' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <!-- pot highlight -->
  <path d='M32 64 L40 64 L38 95 Q35 95 33 93 Z' fill='#f0a066' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='56' height='10' rx='3' fill='url(#potRim)'/>
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='56' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f7b07a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='5' fill='url(#soil)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='57' rx='6' ry='2' fill='#8a6340' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58.5' rx='4' ry='1.5' fill='#8a6340' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- main cactus body -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q62 22 63 40 L63 56 L37 56 L37 40 Q38 22 50 20 Z' fill='url(#cactusBody)'/>
  <!-- body highlight stripe -->
  <path d='M46 23 Q50 22 52 24 L52 54 L46 54 Z' fill='#7ee89a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- top dome highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='25' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#9df0b2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- vertical ribs -->
  <path d='M41 30 L41 55' stroke='#1a6a3a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 24 L50 55' stroke='#1a6a3a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M59 30 L59 55' stroke='#1a6a3a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d='M37 44 Q27 44 26 36 Q26 28 32 28 Q35 28 35 32 L35 36 Q35 38 37 38 Z' fill='url(#cactusArm)'/>
  <path d='M33 30 Q30 31 30 35' stroke='#9df0b2' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M63 40 Q73 40 74 32 Q74 24 68 24 Q65 24 65 28 L65 32 Q65 34 63 34 Z' fill='url(#cactusArm)'/>
  <path d='M69 26 Q71 27 71 31' stroke='#9df0b2' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- spines along body -->
  <g stroke='#d8f5c8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='37' y1='34' x2='33' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='42' x2='33' y2='41'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='50' x2='33' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='36' x2='67' y2='34'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='45' x2='67' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='52' x2='67' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='21' x2='50' y2='18'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spines on arms -->
  <g stroke='#d8f5c8' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='26' y1='31' x2='23' y2='29'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='38' x2='23' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='27' x2='77' y2='25'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='34' x2='77' y2='34'/>
  </g>

  <!-- flower on top -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='2.6' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='17' r='2.2' fill='#ff8cbb'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='17' r='2.2' fill='#ff8cbb'/>
    <circle cx='47.5' cy='14' r='2' fill='#ffa9cf'/>
    <circle cx='52.5' cy='14' r='2' fill='#ffa9cf'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='16.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny pink pot flower deco -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
